releaseNotes:
• Official PS Board Master Brand Logo & Icons: Replaced all launcher icons (adaptive, square, round across all DPI densities) and in-app header/wizard/drawer logos with the official PS Board neon green 3D emblem
• Wallpaper Aspect Crop & Positioning: Custom 2:1 crop dialog with interactive vertical alignment slider (Top, Center, Bottom presets) and real-time contrast preview
• Theme Studio Preview Auto-Save Fix: Switching colors and swatches updates the live preview keyboard in real time without overwriting the active keyboard until 'Save Theme' is clicked
• Launcher Icon White Squircle Fix: Added full Android 8.0+ adaptive icon configuration to eliminate white borders
• Shift & CapsLock Polish: Outlined arrow (⇧) for lowercase, filled arrow (⬆) for single shift, and underline glyph (⇪) for double-tap CapsLock
• Return Carriage Enter Key: Unified '↵' return glyph matching modern chat apps
